findings.title: Sitemap lists URLs that redirect, fail or are noindex
findings.fix: List only final, indexable, HTTP 200 URLs in the sitemap.
findings.evidence: 2 of the crawled sitemap URLs are not final indexable pages

findings.title: Redirect chains (more than one hop)
findings.fix: Point each redirect straight at its final URL.

findings.title: Pages without a canonical link
findings.fix: Add a self-referencing rel=canonical to each indexable page.

findings.title: More than one title element
findings.fix: Keep a single title element in the head.

findings.title: Pages without a meta description
findings.fix: Write a page-specific summary. Google may still generate its own snippet.

findings.title: Pages without an H1 heading
findings.fix: Give each page one visible main heading that states its topic.

findings.title: Pages with very little main content
findings.fix: Expand pages that should rank with substance a visitor needs, or consolidate them. Word count is a warning sign, not a ranking factor.

findings.title: Open Graph title or image missing
findings.fix: Add og:title, og:description and og:image for link previews.

findings.title: No Strict-Transport-Security header
findings.fix: Send an HSTS header once HTTPS is stable everywhere.
findings.evidence: Homepage response has no HSTS header

findings.title: Common security headers missing
findings.fix: Add the missing headers: x-content-type-options, referrer-policy, x-frame-options or CSP frame-ancestors.
findings.evidence: Missing on the homepage response: x-content-type-options, referrer-policy, x-frame-options or CSP frame-ancestors

findings.title: No favicon declared
findings.fix: Declare a favicon; Google shows it beside results.
findings.evidence: No link rel=icon on the homepage

partial: Jev judgments unavailable, so content quality was not assessed
PageSpeed Insights unavailable, so performance used crawl timings only

notes.ai: Rules only: Jev judgments unavailable; editorial heuristics, since Google states no special optimization is required for AI features
notes.performance: Crawl observations only: PageSpeed Insights unavailable
